questions.text: What is 15% of 200?

If a:b = 2:3 and b:c = 4:5, find a:c
What is the LCM of 12 and 18?

Find the simple interest on ₹1000 at 5% per annum for 2 years.
If 5 men can complete a work in 10 days, how many days will 2 men take?
The average of 3 consecutive even numbers is 10. What is the largest?
questions.solution: Let numbers be x-2, x, x+2. Average = x = 10. Largest = x+2 = 12

questions.text: A train 200 m long crosses a platform 300 m long in 30 seconds. Find its speed in m/s.
If x + 1/x = 3, find x² + 1/x².
A sum of money doubles itself in 5 years at simple interest. What is the rate of interest?
How many prime numbers are there between 1 and 20?
The area of a square is 144 cm². What is its perimeter?
If a/b = 3/4 and b = 20, what is a?
A person buys 10 oranges for ₹30 and sells them at 6 for ₹24. What is the profit/loss percentage?
questions.solution: CP per orange = ₹3. SP per orange = ₹4. Profit = ₹1 per orange. Profit% = 1/3 × 100 = 33.33%

questions.text: Find the compound interest on ₹5000 at 10% per annum for 2 years.
A boat travels 20 km upstream in 5 hours and 24 km downstream in 3 hours. Find the speed of the stream.
questions.solution: Upstream speed = 20/5 = 4 km/h. Downstream speed = 24/3 = 8 km/h. Stream speed = (8-4)/2 = 2 km/h

questions.text: In how many years will ₹2000 become ₹2420 at 10% per annum compounded annually?
A bag contains 3 red, 4 blue, and 5 green balls. One ball is picked at random. What is the probability it is blue?
A and B invest ₹5000 and ₹8000 in a business. If the total profit is ₹2600 after one year, what is A's share?
How many 3-digit numbers are divisible by 7?
The diameter of a cylinder is 14 cm and height is 20 cm. Find its volume.
In how many ways can the letters of the word "LEADER" be arranged?
questions.solution: 6 letters with E repeated twice. Arrangements = 6!/2! = 720/2 = 360

questions.text: A milkman mixes water with milk in ratio 1:4. If he sells the mixture at ₹40/L making 25% profit, find the cost price of pure milk.
questions.solution: SP = 40 at 25% profit → CP = 40/1.25 = 32 per L of mixture. In 5L mixture: 1L water + 4L milk. Cost of 4L milk = 5×32 = 160. CP of milk = 160/4 = 40/L
